name: vscode-systemverilog
description: SystemVerilog and Verilog language support: highlighting, navigation, completion, alignment, instantiation and linting. Port of the Sublime Text SystemVerilog plugin.

systemverilog.includeDirs.markdownDescription: Extra directories searched for `` `include `` directives, in addition to the including file's directory and any `+incdir+`/`-I` paths in the filelists. Each entry is absolute or relative to the workspace root, and may contain `*`, `?` or `**` wildcards (e.g. `rtl/*/include` or `**/incdir`), which are expanded to every matching directory. Mirrors the `+incdir+` paths of your compile command. Saved per workspace (`.vscode/settings.json`) by **Verilog: Configure Settings**, so each project can use its own directories.

systemverilog.fileLists.markdownDescription: Restrict indexing to files listed in one or more filelists. Each entry pairs a filelist `file` with a `base` directory used to resolve the paths inside it. Supports `-f`/`-F` includes, `-incfile` source lists, `//` and `#` comments, backslash line continuation, quoted paths, `+incdir+`/`-I` search directories and `$VAR`/`${VAR}` environment expansion. `` `include `` directives inside the listed files are followed (the including file's directory, then the `+incdir+`/`-I` directories, then `base`). When the list is empty (or `base` is empty), every supported file in the workspace is indexed. Saved per workspace (`.vscode/settings.json`) by **Verilog: Configure Settings**, so each project can use its own filelists.

file.description: Path to the filelist, absolute or relative to the workspace root.

base.description: Directory the filelist paths are resolved against, absolute or relative to the workspace root. Empty falls back to indexing the whole workspace.

systemverilog.tooltip.description: Display declaration information in a tooltip. When false, the information is shown in the status bar.

systemverilog.hoverMaxSize.description: Max file size (bytes) to display popup info automatically when hovering a valid symbol. -1 disables the limit, 0 disables the feature.

systemverilog.maxSignalUsers.markdownDescription: Maximum number of modules listed when the hover link **Go to modules using …** finds an input signal used in several places. Values above 20 are treated as 20.

systemverilog.portDirectionColors.description: Colors for the port direction badge shown in the port hover. Accepts any CSS color, including VS Code theme variables such as var(--vscode-charts-blue). Missing keys fall back to the default.

systemverilog.oneBindPerLine.description: For module instantiation, force only one binding per line.

systemverilog.oneDeclPerLine.description: For signal declaration, force only one signal per declaration.

systemverilog.maxLineLength.description: Split one line into multiple if too long.

systemverilog.stripEmptyLine.description: Strip empty line inside module declaration.

systemverilog.modImportSameLine.description: When aligning module declaration, put import statement on same line as module.

systemverilog.alignmentIgnoreTick.description: Ignore line indentation for every line starting with `ifdef, `elsif ...

systemverilog.paramPortAlignment.description: Control if parameters/ports are aligned together.

systemverilog.indentStyle.description: Indentation style used by autocompletion and beautifier when force is enabled.

systemverilog.alwaysNameAuto.description: Look for existing always block in the file to retrieve name of clk/reset.

systemverilog.alwaysFfBeginEnd.description: Enclose the whole always block with begin/end.

systemverilog.alwaysOneCursor.description: Simplify the snippet to position the cursor on the first line.

systemverilog.alwaysLabel.description: Enable label for always block (only if begin/end are present).

systemverilog.alwaysSvOnly.description: In .sv file only display completion for always_comb, always_ff or always_latch (no simple always).

systemverilog.clkEnName.description: Default clock enable name. Empty string if you do not want a clock enable in the snippet.

systemverilog.alwaysCeAuto.description: Insert the clock enable part only if the clk enable signal has been declared.

systemverilog.endLabelComment.description: List of end keywords which should use a comment style (end // label) instead of an identifier style (end : label) on auto-completion.

systemverilog.fillparam.description: On module instantiation with parameter, the user is asked a value for each parameter.

systemverilog.paramOneline.description: On module instantiation with parameter, check if parameter binding can fit on one line.

systemverilog.instOneline.description: On module instantiation check if complete instantiation can fit on one line.

systemverilog.autoconnect.description: Control if signals are created and connected in module instantiation.

systemverilog.paramExplicit.description: Control if parameter setting is explicit (appears in module instantiation even when default is used).

systemverilog.paramPropagate.description: Control if symbolic parameters are used instead of default value.

systemverilog.autoconnectAllowSuffix.description: Expand search for signal to port_\w+.

systemverilog.autoconnectPortPrefix.description: List of prefixes to remove from the port before looking for a signal connection.

systemverilog.autoconnectPortSuffix.description: List of suffixes to remove from the port before looking for a signal connection.

systemverilog.instancePrefix.description: Prefix to the module instantiation name.

systemverilog.instanceSuffix.description: Suffix to the module instantiation name.

systemverilog.declStart.description: Pattern to find for start of signals auto-declaration. Empty string to get declaration just above instantiation.

systemverilog.declEnd.description: Pattern to find just after start to insert signal declaration before. Empty string to use first empty line after start pattern.

systemverilog.declIndent.description: Number of indentation levels for signal declaration.

systemverilog.debug.description: Display debug information in the console.

systemverilog.completionSystemtask.description: System task completion list. Each entry is [trigger, description, snippet].

systemverilog.completionSystemtaskUser.description: User additions/overrides for the system task completion list.

systemverilog.completionTickUser.description: User additions/overrides for the compiler directive completion list.

systemverilog.completionUvmUser.description: User additions/overrides for the UVM completion list.
